source:
flowchart TD
    start([Request received]) --> valid{Valid input?}
    valid -->|no| reject[Return 400]
    valid -->|yes| cached{In cache?}
    cached -->|yes| serve[Serve cached copy]
    cached -->|no| auth{Authorised?}
    auth -->|no| deny[Return 403]
    auth -->|yes| quota{Under quota?}
    quota -->|no| throttle[Return 429]
    quota -->|yes| fetch[Fetch from origin]
    fetch --> ok{Origin OK?}
    ok -->|yes| store[Store in cache]
    ok -->|no| stale{Stale copy?}
    stale -->|yes| serve
    stale -->|no| error[Return 502]
    store --> serve
    serve --> log[(Access log)]
    reject --> log
    deny --> log
    throttle --> log
    error --> log
    log --> finish([Done])
